title: sdks: unify auth/retries and streaming ergonomics across python/ts/go + parity bumps
author: Priya Kothari
description: This PR consolidates auth and retry behavior, improves streaming ergonomics, and fixes parity gaps between the Python, TypeScript, and Go SDKs. Motivation: multiple teams reported inconsistent retry semantics and developer ergonomics across languages (intermittent 401/429 handling, streaming disconnect semantics, and mismatched helper APIs). Changes are: unified auth middleware (single token refresh + backoff strategy), consistent retryable-status mapping (401,429,5xx with configurable backoff), streaming client ergonomics (Python async iterator, TS streaming Response + convenience helpers, Go StreamReader interface), parity fixes for shape/params across SDKs, version bumps and changelog updates, CI matrix additions to cover streaming smoke tests. The description below summarizes architecture decisions and migration notes: 1) Auth/retries: introduce AuthRetryPolicy that isolates token refresh from retry backoff; default uses exponential backoff with jitter and respects Retry-After header; SDKs expose opt-in per-request overrides. 2) Streaming ergonomics: stable, small-surface helpers that return typed iterators/streams and centralize reconnect logic behind opt-in settings. 3) Parity: align method names and parameter names (generate_text -> create_completion in TS/Go to match Python; streaming->stream_chat across SDKs). 4) Versioning: bump python to 1.6.0, typescript to 0.24.0, go to v0.13.0 and update CHANGELOGs. Migration notes included in each SDK CHANGELOG; no breaking changes by default but clients relying on old names will see deprecation warnings for one release. See commits, changed files, and review thread for details.
commits: python: add async streaming iterator helper and tests
typescript: streaming client ergonomics + helper functions
typescript: unify retry mapping and respect Retry-After
go: introduce StreamReader interface and retry middleware
go: rename GenerateText->CreateCompletion for parity (deprecated alias added)
chore: bump sdk versions and update changelogs
tests: add streaming smoke tests to CI matrix
ci: expand matrix for python/ts/go streaming tests
review_thread: Evan Zhang: Overall this looks great; big 👍 on centralizing retry behavior. A few nits: add an opt-out for the Retry-After handling for some legacy endpoints and document the default limits.
Priya Kothari: Thanks Evan, added retry_after_opt_out flag to the AuthRetryPolicy across SDKs and documented defaults in CHANGELOG entries.
Marta Silva: Can you clarify the streaming reconnect semantics? Are we auto-reconnecting by default? We should be conservative here.

Priya Kothari: Good call. Default is no automatic reconnect to avoid duplicating partial events. We added an explicit `auto_reconnect` opt-in flag and documented typical usage patterns in docs/sdk-migration-auth-retries.md.
Jonah Patel: Tests look solid but CI flakes on macos-latest for the python streaming test. Suggest adding a small retry wrapper in the test harness.
Priya Kothari: Added a retry wrapper and bumped the timeout in CI. Reran CI and green.
Marta Silva: Approving pending changelog wording for the deprecation notices.
Evan Zhang: Approved and squashed commits locally; good to merge once CI is green.
release_notes: SDKs: unified auth/retry policy, streaming ergonomics improvements, parity renames and version bumps. Python 1.6.0, TypeScript 0.24.0, Go v0.13.0. See individual SDK CHANGELOGs for migration steps.
